rate_proposal.note: FSoE has no own bitrate, universal safe-data maximum or universal watchdog default. Base one-byte/even-block container requires configured directional data/mapping, CRC chain and endpoint watchdog. Black channel and optional enhancements need their own profiles; no automatic SIL/PL acceptance.
